hero.lead: Turn your sound into a finished record.
hero.description: Recording, vocal editing, mixing and mastering in one package. New to recording? We'll help you prepare and find the right performance.

ocean.title:
Make new music
with the sound of this island.
ocean.body:
Sea, streets, people, culture.
Your sound from Okinawa to the world.

package.heading:
One song.
All the way through.
package.description: No recording experience needed. If you have a beat but are still working on your delivery, we'll help you take the next step.
package.support: When useful, we can plan a preproduction session and help you focus your practice before the final take.

works.heading:

works.description: A selection of music projects STUDIO SNACK has been involved in, across hip-hop and other genres.
works.label: Selected work

flow.heading: First time? You're in good hands.
flow.intro: We're with you from the first conversation to the finished track. Even if your idea is still taking shape, let's talk.

items.title: Prepare
items.body: We review your song and lyrics.

items.title: Record
items.body: Find your best take in a relaxed space.

items.title: Edit & mix
items.body: We refine the details and build the song.

profile.heading: Tough Saki
profile.body: Based in Okinawa, Tough Saki supports artists making music, especially hip-hop. The work goes beyond recording: together we aim to create songs that reach listeners. If it's your first session, you're welcome here.

finalCta.heading:
Your next song
starts here.
finalCta.body: Tell us what you want to create.

price.heading: One song. All the way through.
price.intro: A simple package with the essential production steps. Whatever stage your song is at, we'll help you move forward.
price.note: Have more than one song or need extra production work? Let's talk through your project first.
price.prepro: Still practicing your vocal? We can discuss your preparation and suggest a preproduction approach when useful.
price.conditionsBody: We'll confirm session length, revisions and delivery format after discussing your project.
price.tourHeading: Want to see the studio first?
price.tourBody: Studio visits are free. Get in touch to arrange a time.

access.heading: Find STUDIO SNACK.
access.intro: Find STUDIO SNACK in Murokawa, Okinawa City. Please contact us before visiting.
access.address: Hibiscus Building Room 404, 2-1-9 Murokawa, Okinawa City, Okinawa 904-0013, Japan
access.tourBody: New to recording? Come see the space and ask us anything.

about.heading: Make the record together.
about.intro: A recording studio in Okinawa where artists turn ideas into finished music.
